title: Replace VALVE, GATE, WEDGE, OS&Y 4" P300 (4"-P300-P-1021/A2)
notice: DEMONSTRATION ONLY — NOT A QUALIFIED PROCEDURE; THE FACILITY OWNER'S QUALIFIED PROCEDURES AND APPLICABLE CODES GOVERN.
reason: Outlet isolation valve stem packing leaking and seat passing.
scope: Isolate per the isolation list, drain and vent 4"-P300-P-1021 between the isolations.
Unbolt and remove VALVE, GATE, WEDGE, OS&Y 4" P300 (4"-P300-P-1021/A2) at E 53'-6"  N -20'-8-3/16"  EL 109'-0".
Inspect both flange faces (SW-NDE-5); dress or report damage.
Install a new VALVE, GATE, WEDGE, OS&Y 4" P300 of the same size, class and face-to-face (GATE4-P300), with new gaskets and studs, stem orientation as removed.
Tighten the studs to the stated preload in three passes, cross pattern (SW-WO-5).
Remove blinds, restore the line-up, leak test the two joints on start-up (SW-TEST-2).

isolations.description: Line end at V-102-N2: the equipment is out of service, drained and isolated under the shutdown isolation
Close and lock VALVE, GATE, WEDGE, OS&Y 4" P300 (4"-P300-P-1021/B2)
Fit a line blind between 4"-P300-P-1021/B2 and FLANGE WELD-NECK 4" P300 RAISED FACE (4"-P300-P-1021/B5), work side

inspections.description: Flange faces of both joints before the new gaskets go in
inspections.criteria: No radial scratch across the sealing face (SW-NDE-5)

test.description: Both remade joints checked at operating pressure on start-up

parts.description: STUD SET 4 × 1" × 6-1/4" WITH 2 NUTS, FOR 4" P300
STUD SET 4 × 1" × 6-1/4" WITH 2 NUTS, FOR 4" P300

itp.activity: Work permit issued; isolation list (valves locked, blinds fitted) verified at zero pressure and drained
itp.acceptance: Every isolation in place and tagged; zero pressure at the vent
No radial scratch across the sealing face

itp.activity: New valve verified: type, size, class, face-to-face and tag
itp.acceptance: Matches the parts list and the line class

itp.activity: New gaskets fitted, studs tightened to preload in three passes
itp.acceptance: Preload per stud as stated; three passes, cross pattern

itp.activity: Service leak test of the remade joints on start-up
Blinds removed, isolations returned to normal line-up per the isolation list
itp.acceptance: Every blind removed and accounted for

itp.activity: Records complete; work order handed back to operations
itp.acceptance: All ITP activities accepted or not applicable
